narration: Observe... carefully! If every action has an equal and opposite reaction... how can anything ever move forward?
Most scholars assume that if forces are equal and opposite, they must cancel out to zero — leaving the universe completely motionless. But listen closely...
Nature does not permit cancellation here! Why? Because the action and the reaction act upon two distinct bodies... never upon the same object. When a skater pushes a wall, the wall pushes the skater.
And behold! Motion is born not of unbalanced forces... but of forces acting on separate partners in nature's grand dance! Test your understanding in the quiz below.
